title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 34
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 34: Josiah purges the land, the book of the law is found in Yahweh's house, and Huldah the prophetess speaks.

questions.text: How old was Josiah when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: In which year of his reign did Josiah begin to seek after the God of David his father?
questions.explanation: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father.

questions.text: What did Josiah do with the dust of the Asherah poles and images he broke in pieces?
questions.explanation: He broke the Asherah poles and the images in pieces, made dust of them, and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

answers.text: He threw it into the brook Kidron outside the city
He buried it under the altar in Yahweh's house
He scattered it on the graves of those who sacrificed to them
He sent it as a warning to the king of Egypt

questions.text: What did Josiah burn on their altars?
questions.explanation: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.

questions.text: To whom did Shaphan, Maaseiah and Joah deliver the money that was brought into God's house?
questions.explanation: They came to Hilkiah the high priest, and delivered the money that was brought into God's house.

questions.text: What did Hilkiah the priest find when they brought out the money?
questions.explanation: Hilkiah the priest found the book of Yahweh's law given by Moses.

answers.text: The book of Yahweh's law given by Moses
A letter from the prophet Elijah

questions.text: What did the king do when he heard the words of the law?
questions.explanation: When the king had heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.

answers.text: He ordered Shaphan to hide it

questions.text: To whom did Hilkiah and the men the king had sent go to inquire of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Hilkiah and those whom the king had commanded went to Huldah the prophetess, who lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter.

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise Josiah through Huldah?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes won't see all the evil that I will bring on this place."

answers.text: He would be gathered to his grave in peace
He would live another fifteen years
He would defeat the king of Egypt

questions.text: What did the king do in Yahweh's house in the hearing of all the people?
questions.explanation: He read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in Yahweh's house, and made a covenant before Yahweh.

answers.text: He crowned his son as the next king
He moved the ark to Bethel
He read the book of the covenant and made a covenant
He appointed Huldah as high priest
